- `DOWNLOADS.*` - Download page
- `EPG.*` - EPG-specific

   - Text-only favorites/recent hints (too minimal, style-locked)
   - EPG grid empty states (SVG inline, unique interactions)

## Summary Analysis

### **Shared Reusable Components Found:**

1. **`EmptyStateComponent`** ✅
   - Path: `/libs/playlist/shared/ui/src/lib/recent-playlists/empty-state/`
   - Selector: `app-empty-state`
   - Types: `'welcome'` | `'no-results'`
   - Features: Custom SVG illustrations, gradient text, animations, feature chips
   - Used in: #1, #2, #27

2. **`PortalEmptyStateComponent`** ✅
   - Path: `/libs/portal/shared/ui/src/lib/components/portal-empty-state/`
   - Selector: `app-portal-empty-state`
   - Props: `icon` (Material icon string), `message` (translation key)
   - Features: Minimal centered layout, floating animation, 72px icon
   - Used in: #14, #16, #17, #18, #19, #20

3. **`PlaylistErrorViewComponent`** ✅
   - Path: `/libs/portal/shared/ui/src/lib/components/playlist-error-view/`
   - Selector: `app-playlist-error-view`
   - Props: title, description, showIllustration, showActionButtons, viewType
   - Features: SVG illustrations (broken-tv.svg, empty-category.svg), flexible actions
   - Used in: #11, #12, #26

### **Hand-Rolled Empty States (No Reusable Component):**

- Favorites/Recent text-only states (#3, #4)
- All-Channels search (#5)
- Groups management (#6, #7)
- Global Favorites (#8)
- Portal Search layouts (#9, #10)
- Favorites Content (#13)
- Unified Grid Tab (#15)
- EPG Grid (#21, #22)
- Downloads (#23, #24, #25)
- Command Palette (#28)

### **Styling Patterns:**

| Pattern | Files | Icon Size | Title Font | Body Font | Padding | Centering |
|---------|-------|-----------|-----------|----------|---------|-----------|
| Welcome (large) | EmptyState | 200px SVG | 2rem gradient | 0.95rem | 60px | Full flex |
| Portal (medium) | PortalEmptyState | 72px Material | 1.05rem weight-520 | None | Flex center | Full flex |
| Text-only (minimal) | Favorites/Recent | None | 1.05rem weight-520 | 0.85rem | 16-40px | Top-left |
| Search/No Results | All-channels, Downloads | 64px Material | 1.05rem weight-520 | 0.85rem | 40-64px | Centered |

### **Translation Keys Used:**

All empty states reference keys in `/apps/web/src/assets/i18n/en.json`:
- `HOME.PLAYLISTS.*` - Home/playlist welcome states
- `CHANNELS.*` - M3U-specific favorites/groups/search
- `WORKSPACE.*` - Global/dashboard states
- `PORTALS.*` - Portal-specific (search, empty category)
- `DOWNLOADS.*` - Download page
- `EPG.*` - EPG-specific
- Custom hard-coded text for EPG grid, command palette

### **Extraction Recommendation:**

**Yes, extract a shared empty-state component**, but design it in layers:

1. **`BaseEmptyStateComponent`** (atomic):
   - Icon input (Material icon string OR custom SVG)
   - Title translation key
   - Description/hint translation key
   - Layout preset: 'minimal' | 'standard' | 'card'

2. **Specialized components** (composable):
   - `WelcomeEmptyState` (inherits Base, adds features chips + CTA)
   - `SearchEmptyState` (inherits Base, optimized for search UI)
   - `ContentEmptyState` (inherits Base, for grid/list contexts)

3. **Keep separate** (too specialized):
   - Text-only favorites/recent hints (too minimal, style-locked)
   - EPG grid empty states (SVG inline, unique interactions)
   - Dashboard welcome (already using shared EmptyStateComponent)

Current inconsistency: ~40% of states are hand-rolled, missing brand coherence on icon sizing, typography weight, and spacing.

content.text: I have full context now. Before designing the final plan, I have a few key design decisions that affect the scope significantly. Let me ask you 4 focused questions.

questions.question: How should the welcome screen evolve? Currently the three pills (M3U/Xtream/Stalker) are non-interactive — visually they look like buttons but they do nothing.

options.label: Clickable source chips + value props (Recommended)
options.description: Make M3U/Xtream/Stalker chips one-click shortcuts into the matching add-playlist form, AND add a small value-prop strip above (Live TV + EPG, Movies & Series, Multi-source, Offline downloads). Best of both — discoverability and direct action.

options.label: Just make the chips clickable
options.description: Leave structure as-is, but turn the three feature pills into one-click shortcuts to the relevant add-playlist form. Lowest-effort but no extra messaging about what the app does.

options.label: Replace chips with feature cards only
options.description: Drop the source-type pills, show a row of feature cards (Live TV, VOD, Series, EPG, etc.) and rely solely on the big 'Add Your First Playlist' button to start the flow.

questions.question: When there are zero playlists, what should happen to the header search bar, download button, and the Sources page chrome (sort dropdown + Type filter sidebar)?

options.label: Aggressive hide (Recommended)
options.description: Hide search bar, download icon, sort dropdown, and Type filter sidebar entirely until a playlist is added. Keeps first-launch focused on a single CTA. Header keeps brand + add (+) + command palette only.

options.label: Moderate — hide page chrome only
options.description: Hide Sources sort dropdown + filter sidebar, but keep header search (disabled) and download button visible. Less change to the shell.

options.label: Conservative — current chrome stays
options.description: Keep all current chrome visible. Only redesign the empty content within.

questions.question: When there are zero playlists, what should the sidebar entries Global Favorites, Recently Viewed, and (in the new dashboard) Sources do?

options.label: Show with richer empty states (Recommended)
options.description: Keep entries visible, but route to a unified empty state (icon + title + body + secondary CTA back to dashboard or 'Add playlist'). Discoverable, no dead-ends.

options.label: Hide until first playlist exists
options.description: Hide Global Favorites / Recently Viewed / Sources sidebar items entirely until at least one playlist is added. Cleanest first-launch but harder to discover what these pages do.

options.label: Keep current one-line empty
options.description: Just improve label alignment, keep the single-line 'No favorites yet' style as-is.

questions.question: How wide should the refactor scope be? The codebase has ~28 empty states with 3 reusable components and many hand-rolled ones.

options.label: Workspace-level only (Recommended)
options.description: Add a 'no-data' variant to the existing EmptyStateComponent and use it for the 4–5 visible workspace pages (Welcome, Sources, Global Favorites, Recently Viewed, Downloads). Leave M3U / portal internal empties alone for now. Tight, shippable scope.

options.label: Full unification across all 28 states
options.description: Extract a single canonical app-empty-state, migrate every hand-rolled placeholder. High consistency but a much larger PR with many touched files.

options.label: Welcome screen only
options.description: Only redesign the welcome screen; leave every other empty state alone. Smallest change.

input.prompt:
I'm planning an empty-state redesign for IPTVnator, an Angular v21 + Electron monorepo at /Users/4gray/Code/iptvnator. The user (the developer) confirmed the scope. I need you to validate my approach, propose concrete refactoring steps with file paths, and surface any risks I'm missing.

## Confirmed scope (from the user)
1. **Welcome screen**: Make the three M3U/Xtream/Stalker pills CLICKABLE shortcuts that open the matching add-playlist form, AND add a small value-prop strip (Live TV + EPG, Movies & Series, Multi-source, Offline downloads).
2. **Aggressive hide of chrome when 0 playlists**: Hide header search bar, header download button, Sources page sort dropdown, and Sources page Type filter sidebar entirely until a playlist is added.
3. **Sidebar links (Global Favorites, Recently Viewed, Sources) when 0 playlists**: Keep visible, but make them route to a richer unified empty state with icon + title + body + secondary CTA back to dashboard / add playlist.
4. **Refactor scope**: Workspace-level only. Add a 'no-data' variant to the existing EmptyStateComponent and use it for Welcome, Sources, Global Favorites, Recently Viewed, Downloads. Leave M3U/portal internal empties alone.

## Key files I've already mapped
- Welcome empty state component (shared by Dashboard + Sources):
  - `libs/playlist/shared/ui/src/lib/recent-playlists/empty-state/empty-state.component.{ts,html,scss}`
  - Currently has `type: 'welcome' | 'no-results'` input and `addPlaylistClicked` output
  - The three pills are visual only (`<div class="feature-item">` with mat-icon + span)
- Dashboard rails: `libs/workspace/dashboard/feature/src/lib/rails/workspace-dashboard-rails.component.{ts,html,scss}` — falls through to `<app-empty-state type="'welcome'" />` when no playlists
- Sources page: `libs/workspace/shell/feature/src/lib/workspace-sources/workspace-sources.component.{ts,html,scss}` — header has title + sort dropdown, content uses `<app-recent-playlists>`
- Sources filter sidebar: `libs/workspace/shell/feature/src/lib/workspace-sources-filters-panel/workspace-sources-filters-panel.component.{ts,html}` — rendered in context-sidebar via `workspace-shell-context-sidebar.component.html` (variant === 'sources')
- Recent playlists: `libs/playlist/shared/ui/src/lib/recent-playlists/recent-playlists.component.{ts,html}` — renders empty state when 0
- Workspace shell facade: `libs/workspace/shell/feature/src/lib/workspace-shell/services/workspace-shell.facade.ts` — already has `playlists()`, `canUseSearch()`, `canRefreshPlaylist()`, `headerShortcut()`, `playlistSubtitle()` (returns NO_SOURCES_AVAILABLE when 0)
- Header: `libs/workspace/shell/feature/src/lib/workspace-shell/components/workspace-shell-header/workspace-shell-header.component.html` — already conditionally renders refresh + headerShortcut
- Rail (sidebar): `libs/workspace/shell/feature/src/lib/workspace-shell/components/workspace-shell-rail/`
- Global Favorites page: `libs/workspace/shell/feature/src/lib/global-favorites/...`
- Workspace global recent: `libs/workspace/shell/feature/src/lib/...` (need to find)
- Downloads page: `libs/portal/downloads/feature/src/lib/downloads.component.html` — already has its own decent empty state
- App routes: `apps/web/src/app/app.routes.ts`
- i18n: `apps/web/src/assets/i18n/en.json` (16 languages total in that folder)
- The add-playlist trigger flow: `(addPlaylistClicked)` event from `EmptyStateComponent` is emitted to `RecentPlaylistsComponent` → `WorkspaceSourcesComponent` → eventually opens the add-playlist dialog. There's also `addPlaylistRequested` from the playlist-switcher in the header, and the header's "+" button also calls `onAddPlaylistRequested()`.

## Existing reusable components
- `EmptyStateComponent` (welcome / no-results) — currently in `libs/playlist/shared/ui/src/lib/recent-playlists/empty-state/`
- `PortalEmptyStateComponent` (icon + message) — in `libs/portal/shared/ui/src/lib/components/portal-empty-state/`
- `PlaylistErrorViewComponent` (error views with illustrations + actions) — in `libs/portal/shared/ui/src/lib/components/playlist-error-view/`

## What I need from you
For each of the four scope items, give me:
1. **Concrete implementation steps** — which files to edit, what to change, what to add (component / template / styles / i18n / facade signal). Reference exact file paths and approximate line ranges.
2. **The shape of the new EmptyState API** — should I extend the existing `EmptyStateComponent` with a third variant ('no-data'), or split into a generic `app-empty-state` + a specialized welcome wrapper? Justify.
3. **Where exactly to wire the "open add-playlist form for type X" shortcut** — there's a `PlaylistAddDialog` somewhere; find or describe how to pre-select the M3U / Xtream / Stalker tab from the welcome screen.
4. **Risks and edge cases**:
   - First-launch vs returning-user-with-deleted-all-playlists state
   - Routes that still resolve when sidebar links are hidden — should we redirect them?
   - i18n: 16 locales need new keys; is there a stub-translation pattern?
   - Tests that will break (look at .spec.ts files for the touched components)
   - Should the welcome screen's value-prop strip be hidden in PWA where some features (Downloads, MPV) don't apply? (Use `isElectron()` from facade)
   - Any visual-regression concerns with hiding header chrome (layout shift?)
5. **Recommended file split / new files**:
   - Should the welcome screen move into its own component now that it's growing (clickable chips + value-props)?
   - Where should the new shared 'no-data' empty state live (workspace shared lib? new `libs/workspace/shared/ui`?)
6. **Suggested final structure** of the welcome screen layout (no Tailwind, this codebase uses SCSS + Angular Material). One short ASCII sketch is fine.
7. **TypeScript file size check** — flag any file you propose to edit that's already near the 300-line target so I refactor first.

Be concrete. Reference real file paths and line numbers. Do NOT write code — only the plan with paths. Aim for a structured, scannable response under 1500 words.

# Empty-State Redesign Plan — Validation & Concrete Steps

## High-level validation

Your scope is sound and most of the wiring already exists:

- `WorkspaceShellActions.openAddPlaylistDialog(type?)` already accepts a `WorkspacePlaylistType` (`'xtream' | 'url' | 'text' | 'file' | 'stalker'`) — `libs/workspace/shell/util/src/lib/workspace-shell-actions.ts:16`.
- `AddPlaylistDialogComponent` already pre-selects the category from `MAT_DIALOG_DATA.type` via `initFromType()` — `libs/playlist/import/feature/src/lib/add-playlist-dialog/add-playlist-dialog.component.ts:96-111`.
- `AppWorkspaceShellActionsService.openAddPlaylistDialog()` already forwards `data: type ? { type } : {}` — `apps/web/src/app/services/workspace-shell-actions.service.ts:16-26`.
- The dashboard rails component already routes its empty state through `(addPlaylistClicked)` → `shellActions.openAddPlaylistDialog()` — `libs/workspace/dashboard/feature/src/lib/rails/workspace-dashboard-rails.component.ts:324`.
- The facade already exposes `playlists()`, `canRefreshPlaylist()`, `headerShortcut()`, `isElectron`, `playlistSubtitle()` (with `NO_SOURCES_AVAILABLE` branch). No new signal is strictly required — but adding a single `hasNoPlaylists` computed in the facade keeps templates clean.

So the work is mostly: extend `EmptyStateComponent`, change one prop on `addPlaylistClicked` to carry a type, conditionally hide chrome in three template files, and add an empty state to two route components.

---

## API decision: extend the existing component (don't split)

**Recommendation: extend `EmptyStateComponent` with a `'no-data'` variant and change `addPlaylistClicked: output<void>` → `addPlaylistClicked: output<WorkspacePlaylistType | undefined>`.**

Reasons:
- The component is already small (21 ts / 84 html / 486 scss). The variants share no markup but do share i18n contract and the SVG/animation system.
- Splitting forces every caller (dashboard rails, recent-playlists, two new callers) to import a different component. The variant union keeps consumer call sites identical.
- Making the output carry an optional type is non-breaking for current callers (`onAddPlaylistClicked(): void { … }` ignores the value).

Only caveat: the file lives in `libs/playlist/shared/ui/...recent-playlists/empty-state/`. It is no longer purely tied to recent-playlists. **Move it up one level** to `libs/playlist/shared/ui/src/lib/empty-state/` (or even better — a new `libs/workspace/shared/ui` lib) — see "Recommended file split" below.

New API shape:
```ts
export type EmptyStateType = 'welcome' | 'no-results' | 'no-data';
readonly type = input.required<EmptyStateType>();
// 'no-data' inputs:
readonly icon = input<string>('inbox');
readonly titleKey = input<string>('');
readonly descriptionKey = input<string>('');
readonly primaryActionLabelKey = input<string | null>(null);
readonly primaryActionRoute = input<string[] | null>(null);
readonly secondaryActionLabelKey = input<string | null>(null);
// emit type so welcome pills can request a specific tab
readonly addPlaylistClicked = output<WorkspacePlaylistType | undefined>();
readonly secondaryActionClicked = output<void>();
```

---

## Scope item 1 — Welcome screen: clickable pills + value props

**Files**

- `libs/playlist/shared/ui/src/lib/recent-playlists/empty-state/empty-state.component.ts` (21 lines — safe)
  - Change pills from `<div class="feature-item">` to `<button type="button" (click)="onAddPlaylist('url' | 'xtream' | 'stalker')">`.
  - Note: M3U pill should emit `'url'` (the default sub-type used in `add-playlist-dialog.component.ts:75`), not `'m3u'` — `'m3u'` isn't a `WorkspacePlaylistType`.
  - Add `onAddPlaylist(type?: WorkspacePlaylistType)` that emits the typed value.
- `libs/playlist/shared/ui/src/lib/recent-playlists/empty-state/empty-state.component.html` (lines 48-61)
  - Convert each `feature-item` div to a `<button class="feature-item feature-item--clickable">` with proper `aria-label`, keep the icon + label.
  - Below the existing `.features` block, add a new `.value-props` row of 4 chips (Live TV+EPG, Movies & Series, Multi-source, Offline downloads). For Electron-only items (Offline downloads), gate via a new optional input `showElectronOnlyValueProps = input(false)` driven by `facade.isElectron` from the parent.
- `libs/playlist/shared/ui/src/lib/recent-playlists/empty-state/empty-state.component.scss` (486 lines — already big, see warning below)
  - Add hover/focus-visible styles to `.feature-item--clickable`, plus `.value-props` block. Both light + dark themes already iterated via `prefers-color-scheme: light` block.
- `libs/playlist/shared/ui/src/lib/recent-playlists/recent-playlists.component.html` (line 5-8) — change `(addPlaylistClicked)="onAddPlaylist()"` → `(addPlaylistClicked)="onAddPlaylist($event)"`.
- `libs/playlist/shared/ui/src/lib/recent-playlists/recent-playlists.component.ts` — `onAddPlaylist(type?: WorkspacePlaylistType)` + bubble it via output.
- `libs/workspace/shell/feature/src/lib/workspace-sources/workspace-sources.component.{ts,html}` — same change: pass `$event` to `workspaceActions.openAddPlaylistDialog($event)`.
- `libs/workspace/dashboard/feature/src/lib/rails/workspace-dashboard-rails.component.{ts,html}` — line 324: change `onAddPlaylist(type?)` and forward.
- i18n: `apps/web/src/assets/i18n/en.json` (the only one we hand-write; see risks for stub pattern). Add under `HOME.PLAYLISTS`:
  - `FEATURE_M3U_DESC`, `FEATURE_XTREAM_DESC`, `FEATURE_STALKER_DESC` (sr-only / aria-label hints)
  - `VALUE_PROP_LIVE`, `VALUE_PROP_VOD`, `VALUE_PROP_MULTISOURCE`, `VALUE_PROP_OFFLINE`

---

## Scope item 2 — Aggressive hide of chrome when 0 playlists

**Add one computed to facade** (avoids leaking selectAllPlaylistsMeta into individual templates):

- `libs/workspace/shell/feature/src/lib/workspace-shell/services/workspace-shell.facade.ts:142` already has `playlists`. Add right next to it:
  ```ts
  readonly hasNoPlaylists = computed(() => this.playlists().length === 0);
  ```

**Header** — `libs/workspace/shell/feature/src/lib/workspace-shell/components/workspace-shell-header/workspace-shell-header.component.html`:
- Wrap `<label class="search-field">` (lines 14-49) in `@if (!hasNoPlaylists()) { … }`. Header component already injects facade.
- Wrap the Downloads button block (lines 93-117) in the same condition. Keep the "+" Add button and playlist switcher always visible — they are how the user escapes the empty state.
- Verify the divider `@if (headerShortcut() || isElectron())` still renders sensibly when search is hidden — change to `@if ((headerShortcut() || isElectron()) && !hasNoPlaylists())`.

**Sources page header** — `libs/workspace/shell/feature/src/lib/workspace-sources/workspace-sources.component.html`:
- Wrap `<button … class="sort-trigger">` and its `<mat-menu>` (lines 7-32) in `@if (visibleSourcesCount() > 0)`. Hides the sort dropdown only when nothing to sort. (The component already has `visibleSourcesCount`.)
- Optionally collapse `.sources-header__text` subtitle when `visibleSourcesCount() === 0` since the empty state itself carries the headline.

**Sources filter sidebar** — `libs/workspace/shell/feature/src/lib/workspace-shell/components/workspace-shell-context-sidebar/workspace-shell-context-sidebar.component.{ts,html}`:
- Add `readonly hasPlaylists = input<boolean>(true);` (or wire facade directly via `inject(WorkspaceShellFacade)`).
- Change `@if (variant() === 'sources')` to `@if (variant() === 'sources' && hasPlaylists())`.
- In the parent (`workspace-shell.component.html`) where this sidebar is rendered, pass `[hasPlaylists]="!facade.hasNoPlaylists()"`.

---

## Scope item 3 — Sidebar links route to a no-data empty state

Keep `workspaceLinks` (facade lines 177-214) unchanged so the rail icons stay visible. Each destination must render `<app-empty-state type="'no-data'">` when `hasNoPlaylists()` is true.

**Sources page** — `workspace-sources.component.html`:
- Already routes empty case to `<app-empty-state type="'welcome'">` via `<app-recent-playlists>`. That's fine — that's the welcome destination per scope.

**Global Favorites + Global Recent** — both routes go through `apps/web/src/app/global-collection-route.component.ts`. The component template is inline (template: `…` at line 27-45). Two ways to wire:
1. (Lighter) Update the inline template to `@if (hasNoPlaylists()) { <app-empty-state type="'no-data'" … /> } @else { <app-unified-collection-page … /> }`. Inject facade or add a small `playlists` selector.
2. (Cleaner) Push the empty-state branch into `UnifiedCollectionPageComponent` so the unified page itself handles "no playlists at all" vs "no items in scope". Since you said workspace-level only, prefer option 1.

For each, set distinct copy:
- Global Favorites: icon `favorite_border`, title `WORKSPACE.GLOBAL_FAVORITES.NO_PLAYLISTS_TITLE`, body `…NO_PLAYLISTS_BODY`, primary "Add a playlist" → `openAddPlaylistDialog()`, secondary "Back to dashboard" → routerLink `/workspace/dashboard` (or `/workspace` if dashboard hidden via `startupPreferences`).
- Global Recent: icon `history_toggle_off`, similar pattern.

**Sources** falls back to the welcome empty state by design — no change needed.

**Downloads** — `libs/portal/downloads/feature/src/lib/downloads.component.html`. Already has its own decent empty state per your note. Two options:
- Leave it alone (you said "decent").
- Or unify by replacing with `<app-empty-state type="'no-data'" icon="download_for_offline" …>` — only if `hasNoPlaylists()` is true. Otherwise show the existing "no downloads" state. Recommend a small wrapper: outer empty when no playlists, inner existing empty when playlists exist but no downloads. (`isElectron()` is already required to reach this route in practice.)

---

## Scope item 4 — Pre-selecting the add-playlist tab

You already have everything you need. The `welcome` empty state's pills emit `'url' | 'xtream' | 'stalker'`. Bubble it:

```
EmptyStateComponent.addPlaylistClicked(type)
  → RecentPlaylistsComponent.addPlaylistClicked(type)            // libs/playlist/shared/ui/.../recent-playlists.component.ts
    → WorkspaceSourcesComponent.onAddPlaylist(type)              // workspace-sources.component.ts:168
      → workspaceActions.openAddPlaylistDialog(type)             // forwarded via WORKSPACE_SHELL_ACTIONS
```

Same for dashboard:
```
EmptyStateComponent → WorkspaceDashboardRailsComponent.onAddPlaylist(type)  // workspace-dashboard-rails.component.ts:324
  → shellActions.openAddPlaylistDialog(type)
```

`AppWorkspaceShellActionsService.openAddPlaylistDialog(type)` already passes `data: { type }` — the dialog's `initFromType()` already maps `'xtream' | 'stalker' | 'url' | 'file' | 'text'` correctly. **Zero changes needed in the dialog or service.**

The header's existing "+" button (`workspace-shell-header.component.html:55`) and the playlist-switcher's `addPlaylistRequested` should keep emitting no-arg → `openAddPlaylistDialog()` (M3U URL by default, same as today).

1. **First-launch vs returning-user-with-deleted-all-playlists:** identical from data POV — both have `playlists().length === 0`. Verify `WorkspaceStartupPreferencesService.resolveInitialWorkspacePath()` (`apps/web/src/app/app.routes.ts:6`) behavior when last-restorable path was an Xtream route that no longer resolves. Check `getFirstAvailableWorkspacePath()` which is already used by `brandLink`.
2. **Routes still resolve when chrome is hidden:** `/workspace/global-favorites`, `/workspace/global-recent`, `/workspace/downloads`, `/workspace/sources` all still navigate. That's the intended design — sidebar links remain visible (per scope 3) and each lands on a no-data empty state. Do **not** add route guards that redirect — the empty page IS the experience. But: `/workspace/playlists/:id/...`, `/workspace/xtreams/...`, `/workspace/stalker/...` could be reached from a stale URL after deleting all playlists. Existing behavior likely 404s or breaks silently — out of scope, but flag for follow-up.
3. **i18n stub pattern:** repo has 17 locale files (`ar, ary, by, de, el, en, es, fr, it, ja, ko, nl, pl, pt, ru, tr, zh, zhtw`). I did not find a tooling-driven sync. Recommended pattern: add new keys only to `en.json`; ngx-translate falls back to the key string (or to `defaultLang`) if absent. Consider adding the same English string to all 16 other files to avoid raw key strings appearing — a quick scripted insert is the path most repos use, but this is a separate task.

   - `libs/workspace/shell/feature/src/lib/workspace-shell/components/workspace-shell-header/workspace-shell-header.component.spec.ts` — likely asserts presence of search input / download button. Will need a `playlists.length === 0` test variant.

   - `libs/playlist/import/feature/src/lib/add-playlist-dialog/add-playlist-dialog.component.spec.ts` — already exercises `MAT_DIALOG_DATA.type`. No change needed.

- The component is already small (21 ts / 84 html / 486 scss). The variants share no markup but do share i18n contract and the SVG/animation system.
- Splitting forces every caller (dashboard rails, recent-playlists, two new callers) to import a different component. The variant union keeps consumer call sites identical.
- Making the output carry an optional type is non-breaking for current callers (`onAddPlaylistClicked(): void { … }` ignores the value).

Only caveat: the file lives in `libs/playlist/shared/ui/...recent-playlists/empty-state/`. It is no longer purely tied to recent-playlists. **Move it up one level** to `libs/playlist/shared/ui/src/lib/empty-state/` (or even better — a new `libs/workspace/shared/ui` lib) — see "Recommended file split" below.

New API shape:
```ts
export type EmptyStateType = 'welcome' | 'no-results' | 'no-data';
readonly type = input.required<EmptyStateType>();
// 'no-data' inputs:
readonly icon = input<string>('inbox');
readonly titleKey = input<string>('');
readonly descriptionKey = input<string>('');
readonly primaryActionLabelKey = input<string | null>(null);
readonly primaryActionRoute = input<string[] | null>(null);
readonly secondaryActionLabelKey = input<string | null>(null);
// emit type so welcome pills can request a specific tab
readonly addPlaylistClicked = output<WorkspacePlaylistType | undefined>();
readonly secondaryActionClicked = output<void>();
```

---

## Scope item 1 — Welcome screen: clickable pills + value props

**Files**

- `libs/playlist/shared/ui/src/lib/recent-playlists/empty-state/empty-state.component.ts` (21 lines — safe)
  - Change pills from `<div class="feature-item">` to `<button type="button" (click)="onAddPlaylist('url' | 'xtream' | 'stalker')">`.
  - Note: M3U pill should emit `'url'` (the default sub-type used in `add-playlist-dialog.component.ts:75`), not `'m3u'` — `'m3u'` isn't a `WorkspacePlaylistType`.
  - Add `onAddPlaylist(type?: WorkspacePlaylistType)` that emits the typed value.

  - Below the existing `.features` block, add a new `.value-props` row of 4 chips (Live TV+EPG, Movies & Series, Multi-source, Offline downloads). For Electron-only items (Offline downloads), gate via a new optional input `showElectronOnlyValueProps = input(false)` driven by `facade.isElectron` from the parent.
- `libs/playlist/shared/ui/src/lib/recent-playlists/empty-state/empty-state.component.scss` (486 lines — already big, see warning below)

- `libs/playlist/shared/ui/src/lib/recent-playlists/recent-playlists.component.html` (line 5-8) — change `(addPlaylistClicked)="onAddPlaylist()"` → `(addPlaylistClicked)="onAddPlaylist($event)"`.
- `libs/playlist/shared/ui/src/lib/recent-playlists/recent-playlists.component.ts` — `onAddPlaylist(type?: WorkspacePlaylistType)` + bubble it via output.
- `libs/workspace/shell/feature/src/lib/workspace-sources/workspace-sources.component.{ts,html}` — same change: pass `$event` to `workspaceActions.openAddPlaylistDialog($event)`.
- `libs/workspace/dashboard/feature/src/lib/rails/workspace-dashboard-rails.component.{ts,html}` — line 324: change `onAddPlaylist(type?)` and forward.
- i18n: `apps/web/src/assets/i18n/en.json` (the only one we hand-write; see risks for stub pattern). Add under `HOME.PLAYLISTS`:
  - `FEATURE_M3U_DESC`, `FEATURE_XTREAM_DESC`, `FEATURE_STALKER_DESC` (sr-only / aria-label hints)
  - `VALUE_PROP_LIVE`, `VALUE_PROP_VOD`, `VALUE_PROP_MULTISOURCE`, `VALUE_PROP_OFFLINE`

## Scope item 2 — Aggressive hide of chrome when 0 playlists

**Add one computed to facade** (avoids leaking selectAllPlaylistsMeta into individual templates):

- `libs/workspace/shell/feature/src/lib/workspace-shell/services/workspace-shell.facade.ts:142` already has `playlists`. Add right next to it:

## Scope item 3 — Sidebar links route to a no-data empty state

Keep `workspaceLinks` (facade lines 177-214) unchanged so the rail icons stay visible. Each destination must render `<app-empty-state type="'no-data'">` when `hasNoPlaylists()` is true.

**Sources page** — `workspace-sources.component.html`:

**Global Favorites + Global Recent** — both routes go through `apps/web/src/app/global-collection-route.component.ts`. The component template is inline (template: `…` at line 27-45). Two ways to wire:
1. (Lighter) Update the inline template to `@if (hasNoPlaylists()) { <app-empty-state type="'no-data'" … /> } @else { <app-unified-collection-page … /> }`. Inject facade or add a small `playlists` selector.

## Scope item 4 — Pre-selecting the add-playlist tab


Same for dashboard:
```
EmptyStateComponent → WorkspaceDashboardRailsComponent.onAddPlaylist(type)  // workspace-dashboard-rails.component.ts:324
  → shellActions.openAddPlaylistDialog(type)
```

`AppWorkspaceShellActionsService.openAddPlaylistDialog(type)` already passes `data: { type }` — the dialog's `initFromType()` already maps `'xtream' | 'stalker' | 'url' | 'file' | 'text'` correctly. **Zero changes needed in the dialog or service.**

The header's existing "+" button (`workspace-shell-header.component.html:55`) and the playlist-switcher's `addPlaylistRequested` should keep emitting no-arg → `openAddPlaylistDialog()` (M3U URL by default, same as today).

## Risks & edge cases

1. **First-launch vs returning-user-with-deleted-all-playlists:** identical from data POV — both have `playlists().length === 0`. Verify `WorkspaceStartupPreferencesService.resolveInitialWorkspacePath()` (`apps/web/src/app/app.routes.ts:6`) behavior when last-restorable path was an Xtream route that no longer resolves. Check `getFirstAvailableWorkspacePath()` which is already used by `brandLink`.
2. **Routes still resolve when chrome is hidden:** `/workspace/global-favorites`, `/workspace/global-recent`, `/workspace/downloads`, `/workspace/sources` all still navigate. That's the intended design — sidebar links remain visible (per scope 3) and each lands on a no-data empty state. Do **not** add route guards that redirect — the empty page IS the experience. But: `/workspace/playlists/:id/...`, `/workspace/xtreams/...`, `/workspace/stalker/...` could be reached from a stale URL after deleting all playlists. Existing behavior likely 404s or breaks silently — out of scope, but flag for follow-up.
3. **i18n stub pattern:** repo has 17 locale files (`ar, ary, by, de, el, en, es, fr, it, ja, ko, nl, pl, pt, ru, tr, zh, zhtw`). I did not find a tooling-driven sync. Recommended pattern: add new keys only to `en.json`; ngx-translate falls back to the key string (or to `defaultLang`) if absent. Consider adding the same English string to all 16 other files to avoid raw key strings appearing — a quick scripted insert is the path most repos use, but this is a separate task.

   - `libs/workspace/shell/feature/src/lib/workspace-shell/components/workspace-shell-context-sidebar/workspace-shell-context-sidebar.component.spec.ts` — covers variant rendering; new `hasPlaylists` input adds a permutation.
   - `libs/playlist/import/feature/src/lib/add-playlist-dialog/add-playlist-dialog.component.spec.ts` — already exercises `MAT_DIALOG_DATA.type`. No change needed.
   - E2E: `apps/electron-backend-e2e/src/electron-test-fixtures.ts:242` (`openAddPlaylistDialog`) currently locates the dialog via UI selectors — if you change pill markup from `<div>` to `<button>`, verify any tests asserting the structure still pass.
5. **PWA/Electron value props:** Pass `[showElectronOnlyValueProps]="facade.isElectron"` from the dashboard/sources page wrappers. Don't render the "Offline downloads" chip in PWA. MPV-related ones (no current chip planned) — same gate.
6. **Layout shift from hiding header chrome:** `header-actions` is the only element on the right; hiding the search bar will collapse the center column. The header uses CSS grid/flex (check `workspace-shell-header.component.scss`) — likely OK but verify with a quick smoke test. To prevent an obvious "snap" between empty → first-playlist-added, consider keeping a fixed min-width on the search-field container even when hidden, OR better, hide via `visibility: hidden` instead of `*ngIf` so the slot is preserved. **Recommend `@if` (cleaner) and accept the one-time reflow when the user adds their first playlist** — that's a state change they explicitly initiated.
7. **Welcome state appears on Sources page too** — when you click the Sources rail link with 0 playlists, you currently see the same welcome state. That's fine by your scope (item 1), but the Sources page header (`title()`, `subtitle()`) still renders. Consider hiding `<header class="sources-header">` entirely when `visibleSourcesCount() === 0` AND `playlists().length === 0` so the welcome card has full real estate.

input.content:
# Welcome & Empty-State Redesign

## Context

When a user opens IPTVnator for the first time (or after deleting all playlists) the UX has noise that distracts from the only meaningful action — adding a playlist:

- **Welcome screen** has three M3U/Xtream/Stalker pills that *look* like buttons but do nothing.
- **Sources page** shows the same Welcome card *plus* a sort dropdown ("Date added · Newest first"), a "0 playlists" subtitle and a Type filter sidebar with "All 0 / M3U 0 / Xtream 0 / Stalker 0" — all dead chrome.
- **Header** still shows the search field (disabled) and the download button — both useless when no playlist exists.
- **Global Favorites** and **Recently Viewed** pages render bare one-liners ("No favorites yet", "No recently viewed items") with the page title at top-left and the icon centered, creating a misaligned look.
- The codebase has 28 empty states; only the Welcome/no-results pair and `PortalEmptyStateComponent` are reused — most are hand-rolled and inconsistent.

The goal is a focused first-launch experience and a unified, reusable workspace-level empty state.

## Confirmed scope

1. Make Welcome pills clickable shortcuts into the matching add-playlist tab + add a small value-prop strip.
2. Aggressively hide chrome (header search, header download, Sources sort + filter sidebar) when `playlists.length === 0`.
3. Keep sidebar links (Global Favorites, Recently Viewed) visible — but route them to a richer no-data empty state with secondary CTA.
4. Refactor only workspace-level empties; reuse one `<app-empty-state>` with three variants (`'welcome' | 'no-results' | 'no-data'`). Leave portal/M3U internal empties alone for now.

---

## Step 0 — SCSS pre-refactor (required before edits)

`libs/playlist/shared/ui/src/lib/recent-playlists/empty-state/empty-state.component.scss` is **486 lines**, already over the 350-line target. Extract two partials before adding new styles:

- `empty-state.responsive.scss` — all `@media (max-height: …)` blocks
- `empty-state.themes.scss` — the `prefers-color-scheme: light` block

Pure mechanical extraction, no behavior change.

> Skip: do not split `workspace-shell.facade.ts` (1584 lines) here — out of scope; flag for follow-up.

---

## Step 1 — Extend `EmptyStateComponent` (welcome variant)

**File**: [empty-state.component.ts](libs/playlist/shared/ui/src/lib/recent-playlists/empty-state/empty-state.component.ts), [empty-state.component.html](libs/playlist/shared/ui/src/lib/recent-playlists/empty-state/empty-state.component.html)

API change (non-breaking for existing callers):

```ts
export type EmptyStateType = 'welcome' | 'no-results' | 'no-data';

readonly type = input.required<EmptyStateType>();

// 'no-data' inputs
readonly icon = input<string>('inbox');
readonly titleKey = input<string>('');
readonly descriptionKey = input<string>('');
readonly primaryActionLabelKey = input<string | null>(null);
readonly secondaryActionLabelKey = input<string | null>(null);

// welcome-only
readonly showElectronOnlyValueProps = input<boolean>(false);

// outputs — `addPlaylistClicked` carries the requested tab
readonly addPlaylistClicked = output<WorkspacePlaylistType | undefined>();
readonly primaryActionClicked = output<void>();
readonly secondaryActionClicked = output<void>();
```

**Welcome template changes** (lines 48–61 of the html):

- Convert each `<div class="feature-item">` → `<button type="button" class="feature-item feature-item--clickable" (click)="onAddPlaylist('url' | 'xtream' | 'stalker')" [attr.aria-label]="…">`. Important: the M3U pill emits `'url'` (the default `WorkspacePlaylistType` for M3U; `'m3u'` is not a valid value — see [add-playlist-dialog.component.ts:75](libs/playlist/import/feature/src/lib/add-playlist-dialog/add-playlist-dialog.component.ts:75)).
- Below the existing `.features` row add a `.value-props` strip with 4 chips: `live_tv` Live TV + EPG · `movie` Movies & Series · `library_books` Multi-source · `download_for_offline` Offline downloads. Gate the offline chip behind `@if (showElectronOnlyValueProps()) { … }`.

**No-data template** (new branch):

```
[icon · 72px Material]
[Title — translated titleKey]
[Body — translated descriptionKey]
[Primary button] [Secondary text-button]
```

Reuse the centered flex container from welcome but with smaller icon and no SVG. Buttons emit dedicated outputs so the parent decides routing.

**SCSS additions**:

- `.feature-item--clickable` hover/focus-visible/pressed states (Material elevation feel without using `mat-button` so we keep the bordered chip look).
- `.value-props` flex row that wraps under 480px viewport.
- `.empty-state.no-data-state` — narrower max-width (~520px), centered.

---

## Step 2 — Bubble typed event up from welcome

Each consumer of `<app-empty-state type="welcome">` must forward the typed value to `WORKSPACE_SHELL_ACTIONS.openAddPlaylistDialog(type)` — which already accepts a `WorkspacePlaylistType` ([workspace-shell-actions.ts:16](libs/workspace/shell/util/src/lib/workspace-shell-actions.ts:16)) and the dialog already pre-selects the matching tab via `initFromType()` ([add-playlist-dialog.component.ts:96](libs/playlist/import/feature/src/lib/add-playlist-dialog/add-playlist-dialog.component.ts:96)).

Touch:

- [recent-playlists.component.ts](libs/playlist/shared/ui/src/lib/recent-playlists/recent-playlists.component.ts) + [recent-playlists.component.html:5](libs/playlist/shared/ui/src/lib/recent-playlists/recent-playlists.component.html:5) — change output to `output<WorkspacePlaylistType | undefined>`, forward `$event`.
- [workspace-sources.component.ts:168](libs/workspace/shell/feature/src/lib/workspace-sources/workspace-sources.component.ts:168) — `onAddPlaylist(type?: WorkspacePlaylistType)` → `workspaceActions.openAddPlaylistDialog(type)`.
- [workspace-dashboard-rails.component.ts:324](libs/workspace/dashboard/feature/src/lib/rails/workspace-dashboard-rails.component.ts:324) — same change.

The header "+" button and playlist-switcher continue to call `openAddPlaylistDialog()` with no argument (defaults to M3U URL tab) — unchanged.

---

## Step 3 — Add `hasNoPlaylists` to facade and hide chrome

**Facade** — [workspace-shell.facade.ts](libs/workspace/shell/feature/src/lib/workspace-shell/services/workspace-shell.facade.ts) (next to `playlists` ~line 142):

```ts
readonly hasNoPlaylists = computed(() => this.playlists().length === 0);
```

**Header** — [workspace-shell-header.component.html](libs/workspace/shell/feature/src/lib/workspace-shell/components/workspace-shell-header/workspace-shell-header.component.html):

- Wrap `<label class="search-field">` (lines 14–49) in `@if (!hasNoPlaylists()) { … }`. Keeps "+" Add button + playlist-switcher always visible (those are the entry into the empty state).
- Wrap the Downloads button block (lines 93–117) in the same `@if (!hasNoPlaylists())`.
- Adjust the divider condition (line 78) to `@if ((headerShortcut() || isElectron()) && !hasNoPlaylists())`.
- Bind `hasNoPlaylists` from facade in [workspace-shell-header.component.ts](libs/workspace/shell/feature/src/lib/workspace-shell/components/workspace-shell-header/workspace-shell-header.component.ts) (mirror existing `canRefreshPlaylist` pattern).

**Sources page header** — [workspace-sources.component.html](libs/workspace/shell/feature/src/lib/workspace-sources/workspace-sources.component.html):

- Wrap the entire `<button class="sort-trigger">` and `<mat-menu>` (lines 7–32) in `@if (visibleSourcesCount() > 0)`.
- Hide `<header class="sources-header">` entirely when `visibleSourcesCount() === 0` so the welcome card has full real estate.

**Sources Type filter sidebar** — `libs/workspace/shell/feature/src/lib/workspace-shell/components/workspace-shell-context-sidebar/workspace-shell-context-sidebar.component.{ts,html}`:

- Add `readonly hasPlaylists = input<boolean>(true);`
- Change `@if (variant() === 'sources')` → `@if (variant() === 'sources' && hasPlaylists())`.
- In the parent (`workspace-shell.component.html`) bind `[hasPlaylists]="!facade.hasNoPlaylists()"`.

# Welcome & Empty-State Redesign

## Context

When a user opens IPTVnator for the first time (or after deleting all playlists) the UX has noise that distracts from the only meaningful action — adding a playlist:

- **Welcome screen** has three M3U/Xtream/Stalker pills that *look* like buttons but do nothing.
- **Sources page** shows the same Welcome card *plus* a sort dropdown ("Date added · Newest first"), a "0 playlists" subtitle and a Type filter sidebar with "All 0 / M3U 0 / Xtream 0 / Stalker 0" — all dead chrome.
- **Header** still shows the search field (disabled) and the download button — both useless when no playlist exists.
- **Global Favorites** and **Recently Viewed** pages render bare one-liners ("No favorites yet", "No recently viewed items") with the page title at top-left and the icon centered, creating a misaligned look.
- The codebase has 28 empty states; only the Welcome/no-results pair and `PortalEmptyStateComponent` are reused — most are hand-rolled and inconsistent.

The goal is a focused first-launch experience and a unified, reusable workspace-level empty state.

## Confirmed scope

1. Make Welcome pills clickable shortcuts into the matching add-playlist tab + add a small value-prop strip.
2. Aggressively hide chrome (header search, header download, Sources sort + filter sidebar) when `playlists.length === 0`.
3. Keep sidebar links (Global Favorites, Recently Viewed) visible — but route them to a richer no-data empty state with secondary CTA.
4. Refactor only workspace-level empties; reuse one `<app-empty-state>` with three variants (`'welcome' | 'no-results' | 'no-data'`). Leave portal/M3U internal empties alone for now.

---

## Step 0 — SCSS pre-refactor (required before edits)

`libs/playlist/shared/ui/src/lib/recent-playlists/empty-state/empty-state.component.scss` is **486 lines**, already over the 350-line target. Extract two partials before adding new styles:

- `empty-state.responsive.scss` — all `@media (max-height: …)` blocks
- `empty-state.themes.scss` — the `prefers-color-scheme: light` block

Pure mechanical extraction, no behavior change.

> Skip: do not split `workspace-shell.facade.ts` (1584 lines) here — out of scope; flag for follow-up.

---

## Step 1 — Extend `EmptyStateComponent` (welcome variant)

**File**: [empty-state.component.ts](libs/playlist/shared/ui/src/lib/recent-playlists/empty-state/empty-state.component.ts), [empty-state.component.html](libs/playlist/shared/ui/src/lib/recent-playlists/empty-state/empty-state.component.html)

API change (non-breaking for existing callers):

```ts
export type EmptyStateType = 'welcome' | 'no-results' | 'no-data';

readonly type = input.required<EmptyStateType>();

// 'no-data' inputs
readonly icon = input<string>('inbox');
readonly titleKey = input<string>('');
readonly descriptionKey = input<string>('');
readonly primaryActionLabelKey = input<string | null>(null);
readonly secondaryActionLabelKey = input<string | null>(null);

// welcome-only
readonly showElectronOnlyValueProps = input<boolean>(false);

// outputs — `addPlaylistClicked` carries the requested tab
readonly addPlaylistClicked = output<WorkspacePlaylistType | undefined>();
readonly primaryActionClicked = output<void>();
readonly secondaryActionClicked = output<void>();
```

**Welcome template changes** (lines 48–61 of the html):

- Convert each `<div class="feature-item">` → `<button type="button" class="feature-item feature-item--clickable" (click)="onAddPlaylist('url' | 'xtream' | 'stalker')" [attr.aria-label]="…">`. - Below the existing `.features` row add a `.value-props` strip with 4 chips: `live_tv` Live TV + EPG · `movie` Movies & Series · `library_books` Multi-source · `download_for_offline` Offline downloads. Gate the offline chip behind `@if (showElectronOnlyValueProps()) { … }`.

**No-data template** (new branch):

```
[icon · 72px Material]
[Title — translated titleKey]
[Body — translated descriptionKey]
[Primary button] [Secondary text-button]
```

Reuse the centered flex container from welcome but with smaller icon and no SVG. Buttons emit dedicated outputs so the parent decides routing.

**SCSS additions**:

- `.feature-item--clickable` hover/focus-visible/pressed states (Material elevation feel without using `mat-button` so we keep the bordered chip look).
- `.value-props` flex row that wraps under 480px viewport.
- `.empty-state.no-data-state` — narrower max-width (~520px), centered.

# Welcome & Empty-State Redesign

## Context

When a user opens IPTVnator for the first time (or after deleting all playlists) the UX has noise that distracts from the only meaningful action — adding a playlist:

- **Welcome screen** has three M3U/Xtream/Stalker pills that *look* like buttons but do nothing.
- **Sources page** shows the same Welcome card *plus* a sort dropdown ("Date added · Newest first"), a "0 playlists" subtitle and a Type filter sidebar with "All 0 / M3U 0 / Xtream 0 / Stalker 0" — all dead chrome.
- **Header** still shows the search field (disabled) and the download button — both useless when no playlist exists.
- **Global Favorites** and **Recently Viewed** pages render bare one-liners ("No favorites yet", "No recently viewed items") with the page title at top-left and the icon centered, creating a misaligned look.
- The codebase has 28 empty states; only the Welcome/no-results pair and `PortalEmptyStateComponent` are reused — most are hand-rolled and inconsistent.

The goal is a focused first-launch experience and a unified, reusable workspace-level empty state.

## Confirmed scope

1. Make Welcome pills clickable shortcuts into the matching add-playlist tab + add a small value-prop strip.
2. Aggressively hide chrome (header search, header download, Sources sort + filter sidebar) when `playlists.length === 0`.
3. Keep sidebar links (Global Favorites, Recently Viewed) visible — but route them to a richer no-data empty state with secondary CTA.
4. Refactor only workspace-level empties; reuse one `<app-empty-state>` with three variants (`'welcome' | 'no-results' | 'no-data'`). Leave portal/M3U internal empties alone for now.

---

## Step 0 — SCSS pre-refactor (required before edits)

`libs/playlist/shared/ui/src/lib/recent-playlists/empty-state/empty-state.component.scss` is **486 lines**, already over the 350-line target. Extract two partials before adding new styles:

- `empty-state.responsive.scss` — all `@media (max-height: …)` blocks
- `empty-state.themes.scss` — the `prefers-color-scheme: light` block

Pure mechanical extraction, no behavior change.

## Step 1 — Extend `EmptyStateComponent` (welcome variant)

**File**: [empty-state.component.ts](libs/playlist/shared/ui/src/lib/recent-playlists/empty-state/empty-state.component.ts), [empty-state.component.html](libs/playlist/shared/ui/src/lib/recent-playlists/empty-state/empty-state.component.html)

API change (non-breaking for existing callers):

```ts
export type EmptyStateType = 'welcome' | 'no-results' | 'no-data';

readonly type = input.required<EmptyStateType>();

// 'no-data' inputs
readonly icon = input<string>('inbox');
readonly titleKey = input<string>('');
readonly descriptionKey = input<string>('');
readonly primaryActionLabelKey = input<string | null>(null);
readonly secondaryActionLabelKey = input<string | null>(null);

// welcome-only
readonly showElectronOnlyValueProps = input<boolean>(false);

// outputs — `addPlaylistClicked` carries the requested tab
readonly addPlaylistClicked = output<WorkspacePlaylistType | undefined>();
readonly primaryActionClicked = output<void>();
readonly secondaryActionClicked = output<void>();
```

**Welcome template changes** (lines 48–61 of the html):

- Convert each `<div class="feature-item">` → `<button type="button" class="feature-item feature-item--clickable" (click)="onAddPlaylist('url' | 'xtream' | 'stalker')" [attr.aria-label]="…">`. Important: the M3U pill emits `'url'` (the default `WorkspacePlaylistType` for M3U; `'m3u'` is not a valid value — see [add-playlist-dialog.component.ts:75](libs/playlist/import/feature/src/lib/add-playlist-dialog/add-playlist-dialog.component.ts:75)).
- Below the existing `.features` row add a `.value-props` strip with 4 chips: `live_tv` Live TV + EPG · `movie` Movies & Series · `library_books` Multi-source · `download_for_offline` Offline downloads. Gate the offline chip behind `@if (showElectronOnlyValueProps()) { … }`.

**No-data template** (new branch):

```
[icon · 72px Material]
[Title — translated titleKey]

```

- `.feature-item--clickable` hover/focus-visible/pressed states (Material elevation feel without using `mat-button` so we keep the bordered chip look).

# Welcome & Empty-State Redesign

## Context

When a user opens IPTVnator for the first time (or after deleting all playlists) the UX has noise that distracts from the only meaningful action — adding a playlist:

- **Welcome screen** has three M3U/Xtream/Stalker pills that *look* like buttons but do nothing.
- **Sources page** shows the same Welcome card *plus* a sort dropdown ("Date added · Newest first"), a "0 playlists" subtitle and a Type filter sidebar with "All 0 / M3U 0 / Xtream 0 / Stalker 0" — all dead chrome.
- **Header** still shows the search field (disabled) when no playlist exists.
- **Global Favorites** and **Recently Viewed** pages render bare one-liners ("No favorites yet", "No recently viewed items") with the page title at top-left and the icon centered, creating a misaligned look.
- The codebase has 28 empty states; only the Welcome/no-results pair and `PortalEmptyStateComponent` are reused — most are hand-rolled and inconsistent.

The goal is a focused first-launch experience and a unified, reusable workspace-level empty state.

## Confirmed scope

1. Make Welcome pills clickable shortcuts into the matching add-playlist tab + add a small value-prop strip.
2. Aggressively hide chrome (header search, Sources sort + filter sidebar) when `playlists.length === 0`. Download button stays visible — downloaded files persist after all playlists are removed.
3. Keep sidebar links (Global Favorites, Recently Viewed) visible — but route them to a richer no-data empty state with secondary CTA.
4. Refactor only workspace-level empties; reuse one `<app-empty-state>` with three variants (`'welcome' | 'no-results' | 'no-data'`). Leave portal/M3U internal empties alone for now.

---

## Step 0 — SCSS pre-refactor (required before edits)

`libs/playlist/shared/ui/src/lib/recent-playlists/empty-state/empty-state.component.scss` is **486 lines**, already over the 350-line target. Extract two partials before adding new styles:

- `empty-state.responsive.scss` — all `@media (max-height: …)` blocks
- `empty-state.themes.scss` — the `prefers-color-scheme: light` block

Pure mechanical extraction, no behavior change.

> Skip: do not split `workspace-shell.facade.ts` (1584 lines) here — out of scope; flag for follow-up.

---

## Step 1 — Extend `EmptyStateComponent` (welcome variant)

**File**: [empty-state.component.ts](libs/playlist/shared/ui/src/lib/recent-playlists/empty-state/empty-state.component.ts), [empty-state.component.html](libs/playlist/shared/ui/src/lib/recent-playlists/empty-state/empty-state.component.html)

API change (non-breaking for existing callers):

```ts
export type EmptyStateType = 'welcome' | 'no-results' | 'no-data';

readonly type = input.required<EmptyStateType>();

// 'no-data' inputs
readonly icon = input<string>('inbox');
readonly titleKey = input<string>('');
readonly descriptionKey = input<string>('');
readonly primaryActionLabelKey = input<string | null>(null);
readonly secondaryActionLabelKey = input<string | null>(null);

// welcome-only
readonly showElectronOnlyValueProps = input<boolean>(false);

// outputs — `addPlaylistClicked` carries the requested tab
readonly addPlaylistClicked = output<WorkspacePlaylistType | undefined>();
readonly primaryActionClicked = output<void>();
readonly secondaryActionClicked = output<void>();
```

**Welcome template changes** (lines 48–61 of the html):

- Convert each `<div class="feature-item">` → `<button type="button" class="feature-item feature-item--clickable" (click)="onAddPlaylist('url' | 'xtream' | 'stalker')" [attr.aria-label]="…">`. Important: the M3U pill emits `'url'` (the default `WorkspacePlaylistType` for M3U; `'m3u'` is not a valid value — see [add-playlist-dialog.component.ts:75](libs/playlist/import/feature/src/lib/add-playlist-dialog/add-playlist-dialog.component.ts:75)).
- Below the existing `.features` row add a `.value-props` strip with 4 chips: `live_tv` Live TV + EPG · `movie` Movies & Series · `library_books` Multi-source · `download_for_offline` Offline downloads. Gate the offline chip behind `@if (showElectronOnlyValueProps()) { … }`.

**No-data template** (new branch):

```
[icon · 72px Material]
[Title — translated titleKey]
[Body — translated descriptionKey]
[Primary button] [Secondary text-button]
```

Reuse the centered flex container from welcome but with smaller icon and no SVG. Buttons emit dedicated outputs so the parent decides routing.

**SCSS additions**:

- `.feature-item--clickable` hover/focus-visible/pressed states (Material elevation feel without using `mat-button` so we keep the bordered chip look).
- `.value-props` flex row that wraps under 480px viewport.
- `.empty-state.no-data-state` — narrower max-width (~520px), centered.

---

## Step 2 — Bubble typed event up from welcome

Each consumer of `<app-empty-state type="welcome">` must forward the typed value to `WORKSPACE_SHELL_ACTIONS.openAddPlaylistDialog(type)` — which already accepts a `WorkspacePlaylistType` ([workspace-shell-actions.ts:16](libs/workspace/shell/util/src/lib/workspace-shell-actions.ts:16)) and the dialog already pre-selects the matching tab via `initFromType()` ([add-playlist-dialog.component.ts:96](libs/playlist/import/feature/src/lib/add-playlist-dialog/add-playlist-dialog.component.ts:96)).

Touch:

- [recent-playlists.component.ts](libs/playlist/shared/ui/src/lib/recent-playlists/recent-playlists.component.ts) + [recent-playlists.component.html:5](libs/playlist/shared/ui/src/lib/recent-playlists/recent-playlists.component.html:5) — change output to `output<WorkspacePlaylistType | undefined>`, forward `$event`.
- [workspace-sources.component.ts:168](libs/workspace/shell/feature/src/lib/workspace-sources/workspace-sources.component.ts:168) — `onAddPlaylist(type?: WorkspacePlaylistType)` → `workspaceActions.openAddPlaylistDialog(type)`.

The header "+" button and playlist-switcher continue to call `openAddPlaylistDialog()` with no argument (defaults to M3U URL tab) — unchanged.

## Step 3 — Add `hasNoPlaylists` to facade and hide chrome

**Facade** — [workspace-shell.facade.ts](libs/workspace/shell/feature/src/lib/workspace-shell/services/workspace-shell.facade.ts) (next to `playlists` ~line 142):

```ts
readonly hasNoPlaylists = computed(() => this.playlists().length === 0);
```

- Bind `hasNoPlaylists` from facade in [workspace-shell-header.component.ts](libs/workspace/shell/feature/src/lib/workspace-shell/components/workspace-shell-header/workspace-shell-header.component.ts) (mirror existing `canRefreshPlaylist` pattern).

**Sources page header** — [workspace-sources.component.html](libs/workspace/shell/feature/src/lib/workspace-sources/workspace-sources.component.html):

- Wrap the entire `<button class="sort-trigger">` and `<mat-menu>` (lines 7–32) in `@if (visibleSourcesCount() > 0)`.
- Hide `<header class="sources-header">` entirely when `visibleSourcesCount() === 0` so the welcome card has full real estate.

**Sources Type filter sidebar** — `libs/workspace/shell/feature/src/lib/workspace-shell/components/workspace-shell-context-sidebar/workspace-shell-context-sidebar.component.{ts,html}`:

- Add `readonly hasPlaylists = input<boolean>(true);`
- Change `@if (variant() === 'sources')` → `@if (variant() === 'sources' && hasPlaylists())`.
- In the parent (`workspace-shell.component.html`) bind `[hasPlaylists]="!facade.hasNoPlaylists()"`.

---

## Step 4 — Wire `'no-data'` empty state into global pages

**Global Favorites + Global Recent** — both routes resolve to [global-collection-route.component.ts](apps/web/src/app/global-collection-route.component.ts) (inline template, lines 27–45). Inject the facade and wrap the existing `<app-unified-collection-page>` with:

```html
@if (facade.hasNoPlaylists()) {
  <app-empty-state
    type="no-data"
    [icon]="emptyIcon()"
    [titleKey]="emptyTitle()"
    [descriptionKey]="emptyBody()"
    primaryActionLabelKey="HOME.PLAYLISTS.ADD_YOUR_FIRST"
    secondaryActionLabelKey="WORKSPACE.SHELL.GO_TO_DASHBOARD"
    (primaryActionClicked)="addPlaylist()"
    (secondaryActionClicked)="goToDashboard()"
  />
} @else {
  <app-unified-collection-page … />
}
```

Per-route copy (computed signal off the existing route param):

| Route | Icon | Title key | Body key |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `global-favorites` | `favorite_border` | `WORKSPACE.GLOBAL_FAVORITES.NO_PLAYLISTS_TITLE` | `WORKSPACE.GLOBAL_FAVORITES.NO_PLAYLISTS_BODY` |
| `global-recent` | `history_toggle_off` | `WORKSPACE.GLOBAL_RECENT.NO_PLAYLISTS_TITLE` | `WORKSPACE.GLOBAL_RECENT.NO_PLAYLISTS_BODY` |

**Sources** falls back to the welcome variant via `<app-recent-playlists>` — no change needed.

**Downloads** — leave as-is (already a decent custom empty state; out of scope).

## Step 5 — i18n additions

Add to [apps/web/src/assets/i18n/en.json](apps/web/src/assets/i18n/en.json):

Under `HOME.PLAYLISTS`:

- `FEATURE_M3U_LABEL` — "Add an M3U file or URL"
- `FEATURE_XTREAM_LABEL` — "Connect via Xtream Codes"
- `FEATURE_STALKER_LABEL` — "Connect to a Stalker portal"

# Welcome & Empty-State Redesign

## Context

When a user opens IPTVnator for the first time (or after deleting all playlists) the UX has noise that distracts from the only meaningful action — adding a playlist:

- **Welcome screen** has three M3U/Xtream/Stalker pills that *look* like buttons but do nothing.
- **Sources page** shows the same Welcome card *plus* a sort dropdown ("Date added · Newest first"), a "0 playlists" subtitle and a Type filter sidebar with "All 0 / M3U 0 / Xtream 0 / Stalker 0" — all dead chrome.
- **Header** still shows the search field (disabled) when no playlist exists.
- **Global Favorites** and **Recently Viewed** pages render bare one-liners ("No favorites yet", "No recently viewed items") with the page title at top-left and the icon centered, creating a misaligned look.
- The codebase has 28 empty states; only the Welcome/no-results pair and `PortalEmptyStateComponent` are reused — most are hand-rolled and inconsistent.

The goal is a focused first-launch experience and a unified, reusable workspace-level empty state.

## Confirmed scope

1. Make Welcome pills clickable shortcuts into the matching add-playlist tab + add a small value-prop strip.
2. Aggressively hide chrome (header search, Sources sort + filter sidebar) when `playlists.length === 0`. Download button stays visible — downloaded files persist after all playlists are removed.
3. Keep sidebar links (Global Favorites, Recently Viewed) visible — but route them to a richer no-data empty state with secondary CTA.
4. Refactor only workspace-level empties; reuse one `<app-empty-state>` with three variants (`'welcome' | 'no-results' | 'no-data'`). Leave portal/M3U internal empties alone for now.

---

## Step 0 — SCSS pre-refactor (required before edits)

`libs/playlist/shared/ui/src/lib/recent-playlists/empty-state/empty-state.component.scss` is **486 lines**, already over the 350-line target. Extract two partials before adding new styles:

- `empty-state.responsive.scss` — all `@media (max-height: …)` blocks
- `empty-state.themes.scss` — the `prefers-color-scheme: light` block

Pure mechanical extraction, no behavior change.

```html
    type="no-data"
    [icon]="emptyIcon()"
    [titleKey]="emptyTitle()"
```

## Risks & edge cases

- **First-launch vs deleted-all-playlists** — same data state (`playlists.length === 0`); `WorkspaceStartupPreferencesService.resolveInitialWorkspacePath()` already redirects via `getFirstAvailableWorkspacePath()` when the last-used path no longer resolves. No new guards needed.
- **Stale Xtream/Stalker URLs** after deleting all playlists — out of scope. Flag as separate task if it surfaces during QA.
- **Layout shift** when first playlist is added (search field + download button reflow into the header). Acceptable since it's the user's own action; alternative is `visibility:hidden` which preserves the slot but feels half-finished. Recommend `@if`.
- **PWA vs Electron** — gate the "Offline downloads" value-prop chip behind `facade.isElectron`. Header download button already gated by `isElectron()`.
- **Downloads outlive playlists** — a user may delete every playlist after downloading content. The download library is independent storage, so the header download button must remain visible in the empty state. The Downloads page itself already handles "no downloads" with a custom empty state and is reachable via the header button + sidebar rail.
- **i18n drift** — non-English locales will display the raw English fallback string until stubs are added. Add stubs in the same PR to avoid a regression in localized builds.
- **Plan Mode rule** — final plan path is `/Users/4gray/.claude/plans/in-my-app-i-atomic-melody.md`; per project convention also save a copy at `.plans/2026-04-25-welcome-empty-state-redesign.md` after exiting plan mode.

Implementation complete. Summary of what changed:

**Welcome screen** — clickable M3U/Xtream/Stalker pills now open the matching add-playlist tab; new value-prop strip below (Live TV+EPG · Movies & Series · Multi-source · Offline downloads gated to Electron).

**Empty chrome (when 0 playlists)**

- Sources page sort dropdown + count subtitle hidden when no visible sources.
- Sources Type-filter sidebar hidden via new `hasPlaylists` input on `WorkspaceShellContextSidebarComponent`.

**No-data variant** — `EmptyStateComponent` now has `'welcome' | 'no-results' | 'no-data'`. Global Favorites and Recently Viewed routes show the no-data variant with per-mode icon (`favorite_border` / `history_toggle_off`), translated copy, "Add a playlist" primary, "Back to dashboard" secondary.

**Facade** — added `hasNoPlaylists = computed(() => playlists().length === 0)` to `WorkspaceShellFacade`; wired to header + context-sidebar via shell template.

## angular-cli

<General Purpose>
This server provides a safe, programmatic interface to the Angular CLI for an AI assistant.
Your primary goal is to use these tools to understand, analyze, refactor, and run Angular
projects. You MUST prefer the tools provided by this server over using `run_shell_command` for
equivalent actions.
</General Purpose>

<Core Workflows & Tool Guide>
* **1. Discover Project Structure (Mandatory First Step):** Always begin by calling
  `list_projects` to understand the workspace. The `path` property for a workspace
  is a required input for other tools.

* **2. Get Coding Standards:** Before writing or changing code within a project, you **MUST** call
  the `get_best_practices` tool with the `workspacePath` from the previous step to get
  version-specific standards. For general knowledge, you can call the tool without this path.

* **3. Answer User Questions:**
    - For conceptual questions ("what is..."), use `search_documentation`.
    - For code examples ("show me how to..."), use `find_examples`.
</Core Workflows & Tool Guide>

<Key Concepts>
* **Workspace vs. Project:** A 'workspace' contains an `angular.json` file and defines 'projects'
  (applications or libraries). A monorepo can have multiple workspaces.
* **Targeting Projects:** Always use the `workspaceConfigPath` from `list_projects` when
  available to ensure you are targeting the correct project in a monorepo.
</Key Concepts>

## nx-mcp

The Nx MCP server provides tools for working with Nx monorepo workspaces. Use it to:

  - Understand workspace architecture, project dependencies, and configuration
  - Retrieve up-to-date Nx documentation for configuration questions and best practices
  - Explore individual project details, targets, and how to run them
  - Discover available generators and scaffold new code
  - Visualize project and task dependency graphs
  - Monitor running tasks and view their output
  - Analyze CI/CD pipeline performance and history from Nx Cloud
  - Interact with Nx Cloud self-healing CI

  Any kind of work inside the Nx workspace or monorepo as well when working with CI can make use of the Nx MCP server.

## plugin:context7:context7
Use this server to fetch current documentation whenever the user asks about a library, framework, SDK, API, CLI tool, or cloud service -- even well-known ones like React, Next.js, Prisma, Express, Tailwind, Django, or Spring Boot. This includes API syntax, configuration, version migration, library-specific debugging, setup instructions, and CLI tool usage. Use even when you think you know the answer -- your training data may not reflect recent changes. Prefer this over web search for library docs.

Do not use for: refactoring, writing scripts from scratch, debugging business logic, code review, or general programming concepts.

content.text:
Good idea. The new `'no-data'` variant already supports this — just need to wire two more empty states with mode-aware copy.

Plan:

1. **Global Favorites / Recently Viewed (playlists exist but no items)** — extend `global-collection-route.component.ts` to distinguish three states:
   - 0 playlists → existing copy ("Add a playlist…")
   - ≥1 playlist, 0 items → new copy:
     - Favorites: icon `favorite_border`, "No favorites yet", "Tap the ★ on any channel, movie or series to save it here." Secondary "Back to dashboard". No primary CTA (or "Browse content" → dashboard).
     - Recent: icon `history_toggle_off`, "Nothing watched yet", "Start watching anything from your library and it will show up here." Secondary "Back to dashboard".
   
   Need an "are there items?" signal — read from `UnifiedCollectionPageComponent` or compute via the same data sources it uses. Cleanest: pass `(isEmpty)` output up from `UnifiedCollectionPageComponent` or expose its filtered count via a signal.

2. **Downloads page** — apply the same principle:
   - 0 playlists → `'no-data'` empty: icon `download_for_offline`, "Add a playlist to start downloading", primary "Add a playlist", secondary "Back to dashboard".
   - ≥1 playlist, 0 downloads → existing "no downloads yet" but reskinned with `'no-data'` variant: icon `download_for_offline`, "No downloads yet", "Use the download button on any movie or episode to save it for offline playback." Secondary "Back to dashboard".

3. **i18n** — add new keys + 17 locale stubs:
   - `WORKSPACE.GLOBAL_FAVORITES.NO_ITEMS_TITLE` / `NO_ITEMS_BODY`
   - `WORKSPACE.GLOBAL_RECENT.NO_ITEMS_TITLE` / `NO_ITEMS_BODY`
   - `DOWNLOADS.NO_PLAYLISTS_TITLE` / `NO_PLAYLISTS_BODY` / `NO_ITEMS_BODY` (`EMPTY` already exists as title)

**Questions before I start:**

- For Favorites/Recent "no items" state — do you want a **primary CTA** ("Browse content" → dashboard) plus secondary ("Back to dashboard"), or just one secondary action since the user is already navigating? My recommendation: **single secondary "Back to dashboard"** — the empty state itself describes the in-app action (star a channel, start watching), so a button that re-explains it would be redundant.

- For Favorites/Recent — the "This playlist / All playlists" toggle in the header is still relevant (user might have favorites in *another* playlist). Should the empty state be aware of scope and say e.g. "No favorites in this playlist" vs "No favorites in any playlist"? Or keep generic copy?

- For Downloads "0 playlists" state — should the secondary be "Back to dashboard" or "Go to Sources"? Dashboard is more generic; Sources is more action-oriented for someone who just deleted everything.

Let me know and I'll implement.

content.text:
Good direction. Differentiating the two screens makes sense — the dashboard is a "home/discovery" surface, sources is "manage playlists". Same empty state for both flattens that distinction. Here's my proposal before I touch anything.

## Dashboard empty state (modern, feature-forward, no scroll)

```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│           ✨ IPTVnator — Welcome (compact hero)                   │
│            "Your IPTV library, in one place."                    │
│            [+ Add your first playlist]                           │
│                                                                  │
│  ┌──────────┐  ┌──────────┐  ┌──────────┐  ┌──────────┐        │
│  │   📺     │  │   🎬     │  │   ⏺      │  │   📡     │        │
│  │ Live TV  │  │ Movies & │  │ EPG &    │  │ Multi-   │        │
│  │ + EPG    │  │ Series   │  │ Catch-up │  │ source   │        │
│  └──────────┘  └──────────┘  └──────────┘  └──────────┘        │
│      ↑ feature cards: tilted ~3°, lift+rotate-to-0° on hover    │
│        ~140×160px, glass-style with icon glow                   │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

- Single viewport, `100dvh - header - sidebar`, `overflow: hidden`, content centered.
- Cards use `transform: rotate(-2deg)` resting / `translateY(-4px) rotate(0) scale(1.04)` on hover, 200 ms ease-out + soft shadow grow. Reduced motion → just a subtle lift, no rotation (per `userinterface-wiki` accessibility guidance).
- Cards are **non-clickable** here — value-prop only. The single CTA is the big "Add" button. Avoids competing affordances.
- App brand kept (this *is* the home screen).

## Sources empty state (task-oriented, playlist-first)

```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                       📋 (playlist icon)                          │
│                    "Add your first playlist"                     │
│         "Pick a source type below to get started."               │
│                                                                  │
│ ┌────────────────────┐ ┌────────────────────┐ ┌──────────────┐  │
│ │ 📁 M3U / M3U8      │ │ ☁ Xtream Codes     │ │ 📡 Stalker   │  │
│ │ ─────────────────  │ │ ─────────────────  │ │ ───────────  │  │
│ │ Local file or URL  │ │ Username +         │ │ Portal URL + │  │
│ │ Live TV with EPG   │ │ password +         │ │ MAC address  │  │
│ │                    │ │ server URL         │ │              │  │
│ │ Live • EPG         │ │ Live • VOD •       │ │ Live • VOD • │  │
│ │                    │ │ Series • EPG       │ │ Series • EPG │  │
│ │     [Add M3U]      │ │   [Add Xtream]     │ │ [Add Stalker]│  │
│ └────────────────────┘ └────────────────────┘ └──────────────┘  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

- No app brand / no big animated SVG (sources is a tool, not a welcome).
- Three richer **option cards** — each shows: icon, name, **what info you need**, **what content types you get** (chips), and a per-card "Add X" button that opens the dialog with that tab pre-selected.
- Cards same height via `display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr)`, gap 16 px.
- Whole screen fits in viewport; if vertical space is tight cards collapse the description first, then chips.

## Implementation plan

1. **Split the welcome variant** in `EmptyStateComponent` into two:
   - `'welcome-dashboard'` → compact hero + value-prop cards (modern tilted style).
   - `'welcome-sources'` → playlist-icon header + 3 detailed option cards.
   - Remove the old `'welcome'` variant since it's no longer reused (Dashboard uses `welcome-dashboard`, Sources page uses `welcome-sources`).
2. Update [empty-state.component.scss](libs/playlist/shared/ui/src/lib/recent-playlists/empty-state/empty-state.component.scss):
   - Add `.welcome-dashboard` (no-scroll layout, tilted glass cards with hover transform, brand gradient).
   - Add `.welcome-sources` (3-up option cards, equal heights, per-card primary button).
   - Add `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` overrides.
   - Will exceed current 391 lines — split into `_welcome-dashboard.scss` + `_welcome-sources.scss` partials.
3. Update [recent-playlists.component.html](libs/playlist/shared/ui/src/lib/recent-playlists/recent-playlists.component.html) to render `welcome-sources`. Update [workspace-dashboard-rails.component.html](libs/workspace/dashboard/feature/src/lib/rails/workspace-dashboard-rails.component.html) to render `welcome-dashboard`.
4. New i18n keys (with 17 locale stubs):
   - `HOME.PLAYLISTS.DASHBOARD_WELCOME_TAGLINE` ("Your IPTV library, in one place.")
   - `HOME.PLAYLISTS.SOURCES_WELCOME_TITLE` ("Add your first playlist")
   - `HOME.PLAYLISTS.SOURCES_WELCOME_BODY` ("Pick a source type below to get started.")
   - For each source: `*_NEEDS` (what info), `*_CONTENT` (chips list), `*_ADD_LABEL` (button).
   - `HOME.PLAYLISTS.FEATURE_LIVE_EPG_TITLE` / `_DESC`, `FEATURE_VOD_TITLE` / `_DESC`, `FEATURE_EPG_TITLE` / `_DESC`, `FEATURE_MULTISOURCE_TITLE` / `_DESC`.
5. **No-scroll guarantee**: wrap each variant in a flex column that uses `min-height: 0` + `overflow: hidden` on the parent dashboard route container; cards use `clamp()`-based sizing so they shrink before the layout overflows. Test at 720p and 900p heights.
6. Use `agent-browser --cdp 9222` once changes land to screenshot both states and verify single-viewport.

## Open question for you (one only)

**Should the per-card "Add X" buttons in Sources be the only CTA, or should there also be a smaller `[ + Add playlist ]` link/button at the bottom (for users who want to skip the explainer)?**

- Option A (recommended): cards-only — the cards *are* the CTAs, no duplication.
- Option B: cards + a small text link "Already know what you want? Add manually →" that opens the dialog with the default M3U tab.

Tell me A or B (or any other tweaks above) and I'll implement.
